representation.encoder: architecture matched to released Tian AE
representation.lambda_provenance: lambda=0.01 was selected using Phase-1 diagnostics and transferred to z=10 without using d=10 downstream test power. Tian's exact WAE lambda is not available.

phase2.model: frozen z=10 WAE encoder followed by trainable 10->30->30->30 nonlinear C2ST feature head

note: Reconstructed WAE branch because Tian et al. did not release WAE source code or WAE logs. The WAE formulation follows Tolstikhin et al.'s WAE-MMD construction with a standard Gaussian prior and multi-scale IMQ kernel. The corrected HDGM WAE training recipe is matched to the recovered historical author configuration: adaptive representation-training epochs, batch size 1024, raw encoder passed into phase 2 through a frozen z=10 encoder and trainable nonlinear 30-D head, with C2ST LR=0.005. This script intentionally does not use the repo's MMDl RBF helper because its separately estimated XX/YY/XY bandwidths do not define a single common RBF kernel suitable for WAE prior matching.
